# Fixture Provenance

All subtitle dialogue in this directory is fictional and was created for SinhalaSub automated testing on 22 August 2026. It may be used, modified, and distributed with this repository.

`candidate-a.srt`, `candidate-b.srt`, and `candidate-c.srt` are deliberately varied Sinhala dry-run outputs for testing blinded packaging. They are not AI quality benchmarks or human reference translations.

The fixtures do not contain customer, scraped, movie, television, or other third-party subtitle content.
